ctx.x: And I had a conversation with some of the -- in the middle of the streets. There was too much jazz-oriented. So somebody got into the _______ and said listen, let's get into the Cuban _______. So Valdez -- Chucho and the other Valdez, got no relation to him but a relation to (unintelligible) Valdez. (Unintelligible). We got to do something with the guitar, can sing something, to break the impact. And then we go to the other thing.

So right now, right now, inside our orchestra, there's two different _______. Well, almost one _______ the other. Because you take the Santo Bal and the Turo, and the alto player, they played (inaudible) this side of the river. The other side is the Cuban side. In the middle of all that,
(inaudible). Chucho made every side (unintelligible). How long that's going to survive, nobody knows.
